product_one_liner.value: SurveySparrow helps companies collect customer feedback through surveys, chat, WhatsApp, email, and other channels, then analyze and act on that feedback.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page is available.

named_customers.notes: The company facts page says it is used by both named companies.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile lists a company size of 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company facts page gives a San Francisco, California headquarters address.

founded_year.notes: The company facts page gives 2017 as the founded year.

eng_blog.notes: The engineering blog describes developer-authored technology stories and includes multiple technical build posts, including microservices architecture and global webhooks.

public_docs.notes: The public help center contains multiple guide collections, and the developer portal exposes API and SDK documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable open-positions listing includes other roles but no AI, ML, or data-science role title.

model_provider.value: The company facts page names OpenAI (US) and Azure OpenAI (EU) for generative AI; an AWS customer story also says SurveySparrow uses Anthropic Claude Sonnet via Amazon Bedrock for real-time summarization, clustering, and sentiment scoring.
model_provider.notes: The public sources identify different providers in different descriptions; both are retained rather than assuming they are mutually exclusive.

compliance_certs.notes: These four names appear in the Trust Center compliance list; HIPAA is described as a paid add-on on the company facts page.

last_funding.notes: The latest-round database profile lists a $1.4M Seed round in April 2019; the company announcement corroborates the seed amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest known round is the April 2019 Seed round, before the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers listing includes a Business Development Representative role and an Inbound Sales Specialist role.

launched_6mo.notes: SurveySparrow announced SparrowCRM on September 3, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small executive page lists two people; the CEO biography says he founded SurveySparrow and became CEO in 2017, and a company profile reports no major publicly announced executive hires or departures.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The company facts page names these as CRM systems.
